map.计算绳索救援系统机械优势、绳索张力、锚点受力与安全系数: Compute the mechanical advantage, rope tension, anchor load and safety factor of a rope rescue system.
map.系统拉力（控制端张力）T_ctrl = 负载重力 m·g ÷ (机械优势 MA: System (control-side) tension T_ctrl = m·g / (mechanical advantage MA × pulley efficiency η); the anchor load scales with the rope angle θ: F_anchor = 2·T·cos(θ/2); the safety factor is checked against the minimum breaking load.
map.理论机械优势 MA = 支撑绳段数: Theoretical mechanical advantage MA = number of supporting rope strands
map.实际机械优势（含滑轮效率）= MA × η^(n-1)，η 为滑轮效率，n 为动: Actual mechanical advantage (including pulley efficiency) = MA × η^(n-1), where η is pulley efficiency and n is the number of moving pulleys
map.实际拉力 F = 负载 / 实际MA: Actual pull F = load / actual MA
map.两绳索夹角 θ 时，每端受力 = 负载 / (2×cos(θ/2)): At a rope angle θ, the force on each end = load / (2×cos(θ/2))
map.夹角越大，锚点受力越大，绳索夹角不应超过 120°: The larger the angle, the greater the anchor load; the rope angle should not exceed 120°
map.安全系数 = 绳索破断负荷 / 系统最大受力: Safety factor = rope minimum breaking load / maximum system force
map.本工具用于绳索救援系统的力学估算，实际救援须由持证绳索救援技术人员操作，并做系统: This tool is for mechanical estimation of rope rescue systems; actual rescue must be performed by certified rope-rescue technicians and the system must be checked.
map.📚 深度解析：绳索救援系统计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Rope Rescue System Calculation
map.山地、高崖、受限空间救援中按负载、滑轮数与绳索夹角核算机械优势与受力。: In mountain, high-cliff and confined-space rescue, calculate mechanical advantage and forces from the load, number of pulleys and rope angle.
map.评估系统安全系数是否满足救援 ≥10:1 的要求。: Assess whether the system's safety factor meets the ≥10:1 requirement for rescue.
map.训练演示不同滑轮效率、动滑轮数对拉力与锚点受力的变化。: In training, demonstrate how different pulley efficiencies and moving-pulley counts change the pull and anchor load.
map.0.98 kN 负载、2 动滑轮、夹角 90° 的校核: Check for a 0.98 kN load, 2 moving pulleys and a 90° angle
map.按默认参数（负载 0.98 kN、2 个动滑轮、滑轮效率 90%、绳索夹角 90: With the default parameters (load 0.98 kN, 2 moving pulleys, pulley efficiency 90%, rope angle 90°): theoretical mechanical advantage 3:1, actual mechanical advantage 2.43:1; required pull = 0.40 kN; with a rope breaking load of 30 kN the safety factor is 43.3:1 ≥ 10:1, so the system meets the rescue safety requirement; the total anchor-system force is 1.39 kN, about 0.69 kN per anchor when 2 anchors are equalized.
map.安全系数为什么要求 ≥10:1？: Why is a safety factor of ≥10:1 required?
map.救援绳索系统须预留动态冲击、磨损、结点强度折减等裕度，行业通常要求系统整体 ≥1: A rescue rope system must retain margins for dynamic impact, wear and knot-strength reduction, so the industry usually requires an overall factor of ≥10:1; this example's 43.3:1 is far above the requirement, with ample margin.
map.绳索夹角对锚点有什么影响？: How does the rope angle affect the anchor?
map.夹角越大，单锚点受力越接近甚至超过总负载的一半；90° 时夹角因子 0.707，: The larger the angle, the closer the single-anchor force gets to, or even exceeds, half the total load; at 90° the angle factor is 0.707, so with two equalized anchors each carries about 0.5× the total force — avoid large angles that overload the anchors.
map.计算绳索救援系统的机械优势（含滑轮效率损失）、所需拉力、锚点受力（含夹角因子）与: Compute the mechanical advantage (including pulley-efficiency loss), required pull, anchor load (including the angle factor) and system safety factor of a rope rescue system.
